description: The Sun, Jupiter and two thousand massless-ish asteroids between 2.1 and 3.3 AU. Every asteroid attracts every other one: this is the scene the Barnes-Hut solver exists for, and it is selected here by default. Switch to Direct in the Simulation panel to feel the difference, and watch the energy drift figure to see what the approximation costs.
title: Asteroid belt (2000 bodies)
